insight: Regulators are increasingly targeting the distribution channel and product framing (e.g. gas-station 7-OH gummies marketed as supplement-adjacent) rather than only the ingredient claim itself.
FDA's compounded-GLP-1 telehealth enforcement wave establishes 'does the ad make the compounding explicit' as a durable content/compliance checkpoint for telehealth-adjacent DTC health brands.
Review fraud (employee-written reviews, bot-run fake social profiles) is now a standalone FTC enforcement lever independent of whether the underlying product claim is itself false.
